source_contract_binding_statement: The frozen JH01 V1 source contract binds only the semantic observation identity BINANCE_USD_M_PERPETUAL_1H_LOGICAL_CLOSE plus the generic Bar/validate_bars admission boundary; it does NOT bind the monthly data.binance.vision archive transport, which is one admitted helper (bars_from_authenticated_archive) and not an exclusive contract.
provenance_basis: No V1 frozen text requires an externally published Binance archive CHECKSUM; raw provider response plus deterministic digest is sufficient provenance.
target_commit_rule: For every real JH01 V1 origin publication, target_commit MUST be the full SHA of the canonical origin/master commit that the operating worktree is pinned to at record time; PublicationRuntime readback equality and AttestationExpectation.target_commit == signed_target_commit remain the mechanical enforcement.
bounded_scope: minimum same-hour Binance USD-M source adapter
